correctness.rationale: For q odd, the explicit automorphism coordinates reduce the order-two equation to diagonalizable A and an intertwining linear map; central shears conjugate away every allowed f because 2 is invertible. The conjugacy classes are classified exactly by rank of the plus eigenspace. Independent block-commuting equations give full centralizers; orbit-stabilizer matches direct counts. Completed-square Gaussian estimates prove the uniform concentration bound. Brute-force finite-field matrix tests verify all coefficients at n=2 q=3,5 and n=3 q=3, including centralizer checks at n=3 q=3.

value.rationale: Determines a natural complete structural invariant—every involution conjugacy class, its exact size, and stabilizer order—in automorphism groups of an unbounded family of finite nilpotent Lie algebras. This separates group-theoretic conjugacy information from raw parity-grading counts and provides a quantitative asymptotic symmetry-type law; it is not merely a fixed-dimensional table or a char-two idempotent substitution.
